sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》播客。

sentences.en: Today we are announcing campaign finance, bribery, and conspiracy charges against Eric Adams, the mayor of New York City.
sentences.zh: 今天我们宣布对纽约市长埃里克·亚当斯提出竞选资金、行贿和串谋指控。

sentences.en: For the first time in New York history, federal prosecutors have indicted the city's sitting mayor.
sentences.zh: 这是纽约历史上联邦检察官首次起诉在任市长。

sentences.en: The conduct alleged in the indictment is a grave breach of the public's truSt.
sentences.zh: 起诉书中所指控的行为严重背叛了公众的信任。

sentences.en: Public office is a privilege.
sentences.zh: 公职是一种特权。

sentences.en: We allege that Mayor Adams abused that privilege and broke the law.
sentences.zh: 我们指控亚当斯市长滥用了这种特权并违反了法律。

sentences.en: Laying out what they described as a wide-ranging corruption scheme in which the mayor accepted illegal campaign donations and luxury gifts in return for political favors.
sentences.zh: 他们列举了他们所描述的广泛的腐败计划，市长在其中接受非法竞选捐款和奢侈礼品以换取政治利益。

sentences.en: These are bright red lines.
sentences.zh: 这些是鲜明的红线。

sentences.en: And we allege that the mayor crossed them again and again for years.
sentences.zh: 而我们指控市长多年来一次又一次地跨越了这些红线。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, City Hall Bureau Chief Emma Fitzsimmons, on the rise and fall of Mayor Eric AdaMs.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、市政厅记者站主任埃玛·菲茨西蒙斯将讲述埃里克·亚当斯市长的起落沉浮。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月27日，星期五。

sentences.en: Well, Emma, thank you for coming in here.
sentences.zh: 埃玛，谢谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: I can see that we have both brought our copies of the indictment.
sentences.zh: 我能看到我们俩都带来了各自的起诉书副本。

sentences.en: This thick 50-something page document that is very much going to define our conversation here.
sentences.zh: 这本厚达五十多页的文件将在很大程度上决定我们今天的谈话。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a complicated story, so I want to have all the details highlighted by my side.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个复杂的故事，所以我希望在我这边把所有细节都突出显示出来。

sentences.en: It's a good thing to have it in here, and we're going to get to that.
sentences.zh: 能带着它来很好，我们马上就会谈到这一点。

sentences.en: But I think we should start this conversation
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们应该从这里开始谈话

sentences.en: just by observing how extraordinary this situation is.
sentences.zh: 仅仅看看这种情况有多么不同寻常。

sentences.en: Our mayor, Eric Adams, has just been charged with a pretty sweeping set of federal crimes.
sentences.zh: 我们的市长埃里克·亚当斯刚刚被指控犯有一系列相当广泛的联邦罪行。

sentences.en: His future as our mayor is now very much in doubt.
sentences.zh: 他作为我们市长的未来现在充满了疑问。

sentences.en: And I think it's worth saying that he leads a city of 8 million people.
sentences.zh: 我认为值得一提的是，他领导着一个拥有800万人口的城市。

sentences.en: This is a city whose economy is bigger than the economy of many small countries.
sentences.zh: 这座城市的经济体量比许多小国家的经济还要大。

sentences.en: And on our best day as a city, we're very hard to manage, and now our manager has just been indicted.
sentences.zh: 在我们作为城市的最佳状态下，我们也很难管理，而现在我们的管理者刚刚被起诉。

sentences.en: And that's genuinely shocking.
sentences.zh: 这确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: So tell us the story, just to begin, of how we got here.
sentences.zh: 所以，首先请给我们讲讲我们是怎么走到这一步的。

sentences.en: The story of Eric Adams, how it came to this for him and now for us.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·亚当斯的故事，他是如何走到这一步，而我们又是如何走到这一步的。

sentences.en: Yeah, Michael, so I've been covering Eric Adams since he ran for mayor in 2021.
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔，自从埃里克·亚当斯在2021年竞选市长以来，我一直在报道他。

sentences.en: And he is one of the most complicated, interesting, charismatic,
sentences.zh: 他是我在公众生活中报道过的最复杂、最有趣、最有个人魅力、

sentences.en: flawed people I've ever covered in public life.
sentences.zh: 也是最有人格瑕疵的人之一。

sentences.en: And you've covered a few.
sentences.zh: 而你报道过不少这样的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's a very New York story.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是一个非常具有纽约特色的人物。

sentences.en: He's the city's first blue-collar mayor.
sentences.zh: 他是该市第一位出身工阶层的市长。

sentences.en: He's the city's second black mayor ever.
sentences.zh: 他是该市历史上第二位黑人市长。

sentences.en: And at one moment, he called himself the future of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 曾有一段时间，他自称为民主党的未来。

sentences.en: And I think he wasn't the only one who saw himself that way for just a bit.
sentences.zh: 我想当时不只是他一个人有这种看法。

sentences.en: Yeah, he said he could give this national message that I'm a tough-on-crime Democrat.
sentences.zh: 是的，他说他可以传递这样一个全国性的信息：我是一个对犯罪采取强硬立场的民主党人。

sentences.en: I'm a moderate.
sentences.zh: 我是一个温和派。

sentences.en: He called himself the Biden of Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 他称自己为布鲁克林的拜登。

sentences.en: He was viewed as a national leader in the Democratic Party for a moment.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他被视为民主党内的全国性领袖。

sentences.en: But Adams has had ethical problems throughout his political career during the time that I've been covering him.
sentences.zh: 但在我报道亚当斯的整个政治生涯中，他一直存在伦理问题。

sentences.en: He says, I'm a police officer.
sentences.zh: 他说：我是一名警察。

sentences.en: I know where the line is.
sentences.zh: 我知道底线在哪里。

sentences.en: I follow the rules.
sentences.zh: 我遵守规则。

sentences.en: But now that's really in question.
sentences.zh: 但现在这真的成了问题。

sentences.en: So I think we should maybe go back even further to understand how Adams got to this point, you know, where he could be mayor and could describe himself as the Biden of Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我们或许应该追溯得更远，以了解亚当斯是如何走到这一步的，你知道的，他怎么就能当上市长，还把自己描述成布鲁克林的拜登。

sentences.en: And despite the fact that he runs this enormous city, I don't think a lot of people outside New York have really gotten to know him super well.
sentences.zh: 尽管他管理着这个庞大的城市，但我觉得纽约以外的很多人并没有真正深入了解他。

sentences.en: So just tell us that story from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 所以，请从头给我们讲讲这个故事。

sentences.en: So he grows up poor in a tough neighborhood in New York City in Southeast Queens.
sentences.zh: 他在纽约市皇后区东南部一个治安较差的社区长大，家境贫寒。

sentences.en: He's the child of a single mom with six kids.
sentences.zh: 他是单亲妈妈的孩子，家里有六个孩子。

sentences.en: She works as a house cleaner.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲靠做清洁工谋生。

sentences.en: And this becomes key to his biography.
sentences.zh: 这成了他个人生平的关键部分。

sentences.en: This is the story that he tells New Yorkers.
sentences.zh: 这是他向纽约人讲述的故事。

sentences.en: In his telling, he was beaten by police officers as a teenager, and he decided to join the department to change it from within.
sentences.zh: 按照他的说法，他十几岁时曾被警察殴打，于是他决定加入警局从内部改变它。

sentences.en: And that was really the story that he wrote into political office.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他步入政坛时所宣扬的故事。

sentences.en: He was a police officer for 22 years, and he ran for the state senate and then became Brooklyn Borough president, which is largely a ceremonial job.
sentences.zh: 他当了22年警察，后来竞选州参议员，接着成为布鲁克林区长，这基本上是一个礼仪性的职位。

sentences.en: You know, it's kind of mayor of Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有点像布鲁克林市长。

sentences.en: Yeah, sort of a cheerleader going to events, rah, rah, Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 对，有点像拉拉队队长，去参加各种活动，为布鲁克林呐喊助威。

sentences.en: I mean, it's Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里是布鲁克林。

sentences.en: You got a rah, rah.
sentences.zh: 你得呐喊助威。

sentences.en: Yeah, but he always had his eye on being coming mayor.
sentences.zh: 是的，但他一直把目光投向市长之位。

sentences.en: He said that God told him he would be mayor.
sentences.zh: 他说上帝告诉他他会成为市长。

sentences.en: He said God told him he would be mayor.
sentences.zh: 他说上帝告诉他他会成为市长。

sentences.en: Yes, his faith is really important to him.
sentences.zh: 是的，他的信仰对他的影响非常重要。

sentences.en: And so in 2021 comes his moment.
sentences.zh: 于是，在2021年，他的时刻来了。

sentences.en: After months of hints and widespread speculation, Brooklyn Borough president Eric Adams says he is, in fact, running for mayor.
sentences.zh: 经过几个月的暗示和广泛猜测，布鲁克林区长埃里克·亚当斯宣布他确实要竞选市长。

sentences.en: He'd been building political relationships.
sentences.zh: 他一直在建立政治人脉。

sentences.en: He'd been raising money.
sentences.zh: 他一直在筹集资金。

sentences.en: And this was an open seat.
sentences.zh: 这是一个空缺的职位。

sentences.en: Mayor Bill de Blasio was leaving after eight years.
sentences.zh: 市长白思豪在任八年后即将离任。

sentences.en: And in 2021, the city's coming out of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 而在2021年，这座城市正走出疫情阴影。

sentences.en: Well, let me ask you, Eric Adams, about what we were saying is a major issue, as it turns out, crime, policing.
sentences.zh: 好吧，埃里克·亚当斯，我想问你关于我们之前提到的一个重大问题，事实证明，那就是犯罪和警务。

sentences.en: Everyone is worried about crime.
sentences.zh: 每个人都对犯罪感到担忧。

sentences.en: So he has this moment to seize the spotlight as a former police officer.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为前警察，他迎来了夺取聚光灯的时刻。

sentences.en: You can't have shootings in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 你不能让时代广场发生枪击案。

sentences.en: That's going to impact our tourism.
sentences.zh: 那会影响我们的旅游业。

sentences.en: You can't have gang members taking over our streets and having people being slashed and shoved to the subway tracks.
sentences.zh: 你不能让帮派分子占领我们的街道，让人在地铁轨道上被砍伤和推下站台。

sentences.en: And say, I can make the city safer.
sentences.zh: 并宣称：我能让这座城市更安全。

sentences.en: And also.
sentences.zh: 还有。

sentences.en: If Black Lives Matter, if the lives of everyday people of color matter, then we need to look at every area of the country where they're being impacted.
sentences.zh: 如果黑人的命也是命，如果每一个普通有色人种的生命都很重要，那我们就需要关注全国所有受影响的地区。

sentences.en: I can reform the police department because of my background.
sentences.zh: 凭借我的背景，我可以改革警察局。

sentences.en: We could have the reform in justice and public safety.
sentences.zh: 我们可以实现司法和公共安全的改革。

sentences.en: So he had this compelling message in that moment.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时刻，他传达了一个极具吸引力的信息。

sentences.en: And that's what got him all the way to City Hall.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点一路把他送进了市政厅。

sentences.en: And once he wins, what strikes you about the early days of his mayoral to Yemma?
sentences.zh: 一旦他获胜，埃玛，他市长任期早期的什么事情让你印象深刻？

sentences.en: He had a lot of energy.
sentences.zh: 他有很高的热情。

sentences.en: He wanted to be this fun, energetic mayor who was seen out and about the city.
sentences.zh: 他想成为一个有趣、充满活力、经常出现在城市各处的市长。

sentences.en: One thing that can't happen, you can't stay home in your pajamas all day.
sentences.zh: 有一件事是绝对不行的，你不能整天穿着睡衣待在家里。

sentences.en: He famously said, I want everyone out of their pajamas, back in the office.
sentences.zh: 他曾有一句名言：我希望所有人都脱下睡衣，回到办公室上班。

sentences.en: That is not who we are as a city.
sentences.zh: 这不符合我们这座城市的特质。

sentences.en: You need to be out cross-pollinating ideas, interacting with humans.
sentences.zh: 你需要走出去交流思想，与人互动。

sentences.en: That was a direct insult to those of us working from home.
sentences.zh: 这直接冒犯了我们这些在家办公的人。

sentences.en: I was still working from home in my pajamas often, and I told the mayor that.
sentences.zh: 我当时经常穿着睡衣在家办公，我也把这事儿告诉了市长。

sentences.en: But he wanted us back in offices, in part to help the commercial real estate industry.
sentences.zh: 但他希望我们回到办公室，部分原因是为了帮助商业地产行业。

sentences.en: Right, bring the city's economy back.
sentences.zh: 没错，让城市的经济恢复活力。

sentences.en: Yeah, come back to restaurants, come back to nightlife.
sentences.zh: 是的，回到餐厅，回到夜生活。

sentences.en: People were afraid to go back out to restaurants.
sentences.zh: 人们曾害怕重新去餐厅吃饭。

sentences.en: Now they see the mayor going out saying, come back out to our city.
sentences.zh: 现在他们看到市长走出去说：回到我们的城市里来吧。

sentences.en: He was out every night at nightclubs and bars.
sentences.zh: 他每天晚上都出没于夜总会和酒吧。

sentences.en: He was at Zero Bond with models and businessmen.
sentences.zh: 他去过零号地带俱乐部，跟模特和商人们在一起。

sentences.en: I don't even know what Zero Bond is, but it sounds cool.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道零号地带是什么，但听起来很酷。

sentences.en: I've never been.
sentences.zh: 我从没去过。

sentences.en: I'd like to go.
sentences.zh: 我很想去。

sentences.en: I wish the mayor would take me.
sentences.zh: 我希望市长能带我去。

sentences.en: I am the mayor.
sentences.zh: 我就是市长。

sentences.en: This is the city of nightlife.
sentences.zh: 这里是夜生活之都。

sentences.en: I must test the product.
sentences.zh: 我必须测试这个产品。

sentences.en: He is holding all of these ceremonial events, and it's all part of this idea that he has swagger, he has energy, he is authentically New York, and he's excited to be mayor.
sentences.zh: 他举办了所有这些礼仪性的活动，这全都是他那种理念的一部分：他很有派头，充满活力，是纯正的纽约人，而且他很高兴能当市长。

sentences.en: And this is a city that never sleeps, so the mayor should not be taking a nap.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不夜城，所以市长可不能打盹。

sentences.en: He is seemingly everywhere.
sentences.zh: 他似乎无处不在。

sentences.en: He's smiling.
sentences.zh: 他在微笑。

sentences.en: He's seen with Anna Wintour at Fashion Week.
sentences.zh: 他在时装周上与安娜·温图尔一同亮相。

sentences.en: He's meeting with business leaders on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 他在华尔街与商界领袖会面。

sentences.en: He embraced this role of being a celebrity, of being the main character in New York City.
sentences.zh: 他欣然接受了自己作为名人的角色，作为纽约市主角的角色。

sentences.en: They're saying that Eric goes out to restaurants.
sentences.zh: 他们说埃里克去餐厅吃饭了。

sentences.en: Breaking news.
sentences.zh: 突发新闻。

sentences.en: Duh.
sentences.zh: 废话。

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我去了。

sentences.en: And he really loved that role.
sentences.zh: 他真的很喜欢这个角色。

sentences.en: I put in the universe almost 30 years ago that in 2022 I was going to be mayor.
sentences.zh: 我差不多在30年前就在宇宙中许愿，说我将在2022年成为市长。

sentences.en: We got this, New York.
sentences.zh: 纽约，我们能行。

sentences.en: Don't even worry about it.
sentences.zh: 完全不用担心。

sentences.en: But as time goes on, people are starting to wonder, what is the mayor actually doing?
sentences.zh: 但随着时间推移，人们开始怀疑，市长到底在做什么？

sentences.en: His motto on the campaign trail was get stuff done, but we were increasingly wondering what was he getting done behind the scenes?
sentences.zh: 他在竞选时的座右铭是“把事情做好”，但我们越来越想知道他在幕后到底做成了什么？

sentences.en: Was he a good manager?
sentences.zh: 他是一个好管理者吗？

sentences.en: Was he delivering on affordable housing and all these other pressing issues that New York City was facing?
sentences.zh: 他是否在经济适用房以及纽约市面临的所有其他紧迫问题上兑现了承诺？

sentences.en: He ran on public safety, but people still felt unsafe.
sentences.zh: 他以公共安全为竞选口号，但人们依然感到缺乏安全感。

sentences.en: Street homelessness is still a huge problem.
sentences.zh: 街头无家可归者依然是一个巨大问题。

sentences.en: So people started wondering, is he going to deliver?
sentences.zh: 于是人们开始怀疑，他能兑现承诺吗？

sentences.en: Is he the right manager for the city at this incredibly important moment?
sentences.zh: 在这个极其重要的时刻，他是这座城市的合适管理者吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or is he more focused on being seen late at night at a club?
sentences.zh: 还是说他更专注于深夜在俱乐部里抛头露面？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then those of us who were covering him started to notice that he had a loose relationship with the truth.
sentences.zh: 接着，我们这些报道他的人开始注意到，他与真相的关系有些随心所欲。

sentences.en: It started during the campaign with what could seem like a small example.
sentences.zh: 这始于竞选期间的一个看似微不足道的例子。

sentences.en: He said he lived in an apartment in Brooklyn, and so many questions were raised about whether that was really where he lived, that he had to do a tour of the apartment.
sentences.zh: 他说他住在布鲁克林的一套公寓里，结果外界对那到底是不是他住的地方产生了如此多的疑问，以至于他不得不进行了一次公寓参观直播。

sentences.en: There was salmon in the fridge, which was suspicious because he's vegan.
sentences.zh: 冰箱里有三文鱼，这很可疑，因为他是素食主义者。

sentences.en: And the suspicion was that he really lived in Fort Lee, New Jersey with his longtime partner,
sentences.zh: 大家的怀疑是，他其实和长期伴侣住在新泽西州李堡，

sentences.en: which would disqualify him from being mayor because he didn't actually live in the city.
sentences.zh: 这将使他失去竞选市长的资格，因为他实际上并不住在市内。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that question was never really resolved.
sentences.zh: 而这个疑问一直没有真正解开。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: And then a pivotal moment came when I started working on a story about public safety.
sentences.zh: 然后，在一个转折点，我开始着手写一篇关于公共安全的报道。

sentences.en: He often told the story of how he kept a photo in his wallet of his friend from the police force who died in the line of duty.
sentences.zh: 他经常讲这样一个故事：他钱包里一直放着一张照片，上面是他在警察局的战友，因公殉职。

sentences.en: Just a story he would tell wherever he went.
sentences.zh: 无论走到哪里，他都会讲这个故事。

sentences.en: It's a story he kept telling to show that he cared about public safety, that he had been affected personally by gun violence.
sentences.zh: 他不断讲述这个故事，是为了表明他关心公共安全，表明他曾深受枪支暴力的个人影响。

sentences.en: And he said he kept this photo in his wallet to remind him of the sacrifice of police officers, to remind him of how difficult that job was,
sentences.zh: 他说他把这张照片放在钱包里，是为了提醒自己警员们的牺牲，提醒自己这份工作有多么艰难，

sentences.en: and to never forget the legacy of his friend who was named Robert Venable.
sentences.zh: 并且永远不要忘记他的朋友罗伯特·维纳布尔（Robert Venable）的遗志。

sentences.en: So I asked his office, I said, can I come by, can we photograph it for a story that we're working on?
sentences.zh: 于是我问他的办公室，我说，我可以过来吗，我们能为正在筹备的报道拍个照吗？

sentences.en: The photo in his wallet?
sentences.zh: 就是他钱包里的那张照片？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I showed up in the mayor's office and he showed me the photo.
sentences.zh: 于是我去了市长办公室，他向我展示了那张照片。

sentences.en: We photographed it.
sentences.zh: 我们拍了照。

sentences.en: It ran in the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 这篇报道发表在了《纽约时报》上。

sentences.en: And I later heard that the photo was not authentic and that it was created as a prop to show me.
sentences.zh: 后来我听说那张照片并不是真的，是为了应付我而特意制作的道具。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哦？

sentences.en: And that, in fact, staffers of his had used coffee to stain the photo to make it look old, and they had printed it off of Google.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他的幕僚用咖啡把照片弄脏，让它看起来年代久远，而照片是从谷歌上打印下来的。

sentences.en: That's a pretty elaborate length to go, to lie to a journalist from the New York Times about a photo in your wallet.
sentences.zh: 为了就钱包里的照片对《纽约时报》的记者撒谎，竟然大费周章到这种地步。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it seemed unnecessary at the time that the fact that they went to such great lengths to reproduce this copy, I think, was jarring for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 对啊，当时觉得根本没必要，他们竟然大费周章地去翻印这张照片，我想这让很多人感到震惊。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And while on some level it's all kind of petty, it is also pretty revealing.
sentences.zh: 虽然从某种程度上看这有点无聊，但也相当暴露出问题。

sentences.en: I mean, if you're going to lie about something that small, as any parent knows, what else are you lying about?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你连这么小的事都要撒谎，正如任何父母都知道的，你还在哪些事情上撒谎？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The photo raised a lot of questions about whether the mayor was telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 这张照片引发了许多关于市长是否在说实话的疑问。

sentences.en: A Bronx neighborhood swarming with FBI agents earlier today.
sentences.zh: 今天早些时候，布朗克斯的一个社区挤满了联邦调查局特工。

sentences.en: And then in November, something really stunning happened.
sentences.zh: 然后在十一月，发生了极其震撼的事情。

sentences.en: So the FBI confirming for us today that they did raid the home behind me, which records show belonged to Winnie Greco.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局今天向我们证实，他们确实搜查了我身后的这栋房子，记录显示该房产属于温妮·格雷科（Winnie Greco）。

sentences.en: Federal investigators raided the home of one of his top campaign fundraisers and one of his staffers.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查人员搜查了他的一位核心竞选筹款人和一名幕僚的住所。

sentences.en: We want to turn now to some breaking news out of New York City.
sentences.zh: 我们现在把焦点转向纽约市的一些突发新闻。

sentences.en: CBS News has confirmed that the FBI seized Mayor Eric Adams' electronic devices this week.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻（CBS News）已证实，联邦调查局本周查封了纽约市长埃里克·亚当斯的电子设备。

sentences.en: And then they actually stopped the mayor on the street and federal agents took his phone.
sentences.zh: 而且他们实际上在街上拦下了市长，联邦特工拿走了他的手机。

sentences.en: Mayor Adams has insisted this week that he has not been accused of any wrongdoing and that he has nothing to hide.
sentences.zh: 亚当斯市长本周坚称，他没有被指控有任何不当行为，他没有什么好隐瞒的。

sentences.en: So we are waiting to see what else comes up in this investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正拭目以待，看这次调查还会爆出什么料。

sentences.en: So now we understand that there's a federal investigation into the mayor and those in his inner circle.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们了解到，联邦正在对市长及其核心圈子展开调查。

sentences.en: It was a stunning piece of news for New Yorkers.
sentences.zh: 对纽约人来说，这是一条令人震惊的消息。

sentences.en: And it was in November, in that moment, that everyone started to wonder, did he not just have a problem with the truth, but did he possibly have a problem with the law?
sentences.zh: 正是在十一月那个时刻，每个人开始产生疑问：他不仅是对真相有问题，他是不是连对法律都有问题？

sentences.en: And we started to wonder whether a mayor who talked about knowing where the line was and not crossing it, maybe he didn't know where that line was, and he actually had crossed it.
sentences.zh: 我们开始怀疑，一个整天谈论知道底线在哪里、绝不越界的市长，也许他根本不知道底线在哪里，并且其实已经越界了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露（Winnalou）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“字字相连”（Connections）谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是山姆·阿泽斯基（Sam Azersky），我每天负责创作“拼字比赛”（Spelling Bee）和“字母箱”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“色听”的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时，我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So Emma, take us inside this indictment against Mayor Adams that was filed on Thursday
sentences.zh: 那么艾玛，给我们讲讲周四提交的针对亚当斯市长的起诉书内部的情况吧，

sentences.en: and definitely suggests, when you read it, allegedly, that Mayor Adams didn't know where the line was.
sentences.zh: 当你阅读它时，它明确暗示（据称）亚当斯市长并不知道底线在哪里。

sentences.en: What is the story that it tells?
sentences.zh: 它讲述了一个什么故事？

sentences.en: Yeah, it lays out a story that starts really before he's mayor and continues once he's taken office,
sentences.zh: 是的，它梳理了一个故事，从他担任市长之前开始，一直延续到他上任之后，

sentences.en: in which foreign nationals are giving him illegal campaign donations and free gifts, free trips,
sentences.zh: 在此期间，外国国民向他提供非法的竞选捐款、免费礼物、免费旅行，

sentences.en: and ultimately they want something in return, which Adams, according to the indictment, allegedly gives them.
sentences.zh: 最终他们希望得到回报，而根据起诉书，亚当斯涉嫌满足了他们的要求。

sentences.en: Okay, walk us through what all these elements you just described actually look like according to the indictment.
sentences.zh: 好的，请根据起诉书，为我们详细梳理你刚才描述的这些要素到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: So when he was Brooklyn Borough President, starting around 2015, he takes these two official trips to Turkey.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他担任布鲁克林区长时，大约从2015年开始，他进行了两次前往土耳其的官方访问。

sentences.en: He had close relationships with many ethnic communities in New York City.
sentences.zh: 他与纽约市的许多族裔社区保持着紧密联系。

sentences.en: There's a lot of immigrants living in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林居住着大量移民。

sentences.en: And so he had these liaisons.
sentences.zh: 所以他设立了这些联络员。

sentences.en: It was their job to have close relationships with ethnic communities.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作就是与各族裔社区保持密切关系。

sentences.en: And so he travels to Turkey, where he meets with the people who end up being his main contacts within Turkey.
sentences.zh: 于是他前往土耳其，在那里遇到了最终成为他在土耳其主要联络人的人。

sentences.en: And he starts getting these free airline tickets on Turkish Airlines to keep traveling to Turkey and all over the world.
sentences.zh: 他开始获得土耳其航空公司（Turkish Airlines）的免费机票，以便继续前往土耳其和世界各地旅行。

sentences.en: And by 2017, he's taking a trip on Turkish Airlines to France, Turkey, and China,
sentences.zh: 到2017年，他乘坐土耳其航空公司的航班前往法国、土耳其和中国，

sentences.en: and getting free business class tickets and a heavily discounted luxury hotel room in this suite called the Bentley Suite at the St. Regis, Istanbul.
sentences.zh: 并获得了免费的商务舱机票，以及伊斯坦布尔圣瑞吉酒店（St. Regis）名为“本特利套房”（Bentley Suite）的豪华套房的大幅折扣。

sentences.en: The indictment has photos of the suites, quite nice, luxury hotel room.
sentences.zh: 起诉书里有这些套房的照片，相当漂亮，是豪华酒店房间。

sentences.en: On this trip alone, Adams accepts $41,000 in free travel from these foreign entities.
sentences.zh: 仅凭这次旅行，亚当斯就接受了这些外国实体提供的价值41,000美元的免费旅行。

sentences.en: That's a lot of money and seemingly a very nice trip.
sentences.zh: 这可是一大笔钱，而且看起来是一次非常棒的旅行。

sentences.en: Yeah, and then we get to the donations.
sentences.zh: 是的，然后我们来看看捐款。

sentences.en: This starts in 2018.
sentences.zh: 这始于2018年。

sentences.en: Adams has his eye on becoming mayor.
sentences.zh: 亚当斯一心想当市长。

sentences.en: So he's borough president but thinking about becoming mayor.
sentences.zh: 所以他是区长，但心里想着要当市长。

sentences.en: Yes, and Adams solicits and receives a number of illegal donations from Turkish nationals.
sentences.zh: 是的，亚当斯向土耳其国民索取并接受了大量非法捐款。

sentences.en: And according to the indictment, he uses them to exploit the campaign finance system in New York City, which allows you to match those dollars to bring in more money.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，他利用这些捐款来操纵纽约市的竞选财政系统，该系统允许你将这些资金进行匹配以筹集更多资金。

sentences.en: Just explain how that works and why the fact that the donations were illegal and from foreigners matters.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这是如何运作的，以及为什么捐款是非法的且来自外国人这一点很重要。

sentences.en: You're not allowed to take donations from foreign nationals at all.
sentences.zh: 你根本不能接受外国国民的捐款。

sentences.en: And he was accepting these donations and then using them under this public match system.
sentences.zh: 而他却在接受这些捐款，然后在这个公共匹配系统下使用它们。

sentences.en: If I give $1 to a candidate, you then get public matching funds, and it makes your campaign haul much bigger.
sentences.zh: 如果我给候选人捐1美元，你就能获得公共配套资金，这会让你的竞选筹款规模大得多。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And Adams would have understood that.
sentences.zh: 亚当斯对此心知肚明。

sentences.en: So he's taking illegal donations and putting them into his campaign and triggering that matching funding system that basically you and I and New York City taxpayers pay for.
sentences.zh: 所以他收受非法捐款并将其投入到竞选中，触发了基本上由你、我和纽约市纳税人支付的配套资金系统。

sentences.en: And it's illegal and pretty wasteful.
sentences.zh: 这是非法的，而且相当浪费。

sentences.en: Yeah, the indictment says overall his campaign collected $10 million in public matching funds for his campaign for mayor.
sentences.zh: 是的，起诉书称，他的市长竞选活动总共筹集了1000万美元的公共配套资金。

sentences.en: And we don't know how much of that money came from these illegal Turkish donations, but we know it was a meaningful amount.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道其中有多少钱来自这些非法的土耳其捐款，但我们知道这是一个相当可观的数额。

sentences.en: Okay, and what do these Turkish foreign nationals who are giving Adams campaign donations and free airline tickets and this luxury hotel suite,
sentences.zh: 好的，那么这些向亚当斯提供竞选捐款、免费机票和豪华酒店套房的土耳其外国国民，

sentences.en: what are they seeking in return from Adams?
sentences.zh: 他们希望从亚当斯那里得到什么回报？

sentences.en: So we see this really vivid example in the indictment in 2021 in the story of this Turkish consulate building.
sentences.zh: 我们在起诉书中看到了一个非常生动的例子，发生在2021年关于土耳其领事馆大楼的故事中。

sentences.en: The Turkish government wants to build a 36-story building in Manhattan, and they want to open it in time for the Turkish president to visit
sentences.zh: 土耳其政府想在曼哈顿建造一栋36层的大楼，他们希望在土耳其总统访问期间将其开放，

sentences.en: while he's here in New York City for the United Nations General Assembly.
sentences.zh: 当时他正因联合国大会而来到纽约市。

sentences.en: Naturally.
sentences.zh: 理所当然。

sentences.en: They have a problem, though, because the fire department has to sign off on these fire inspections for the building.
sentences.zh: 不过他们遇到了一个问题，因为消防部门必须对这栋大楼的消防检查进行签字批准。

sentences.en: So a Turkish official reaches out to one of the mayor's aides, and he states that because Turkey had supported Adams,
sentences.zh: 因此，一名土耳其官员联系了市长的一位幕僚，他表示，由于土耳其曾支持过亚当斯，

sentences.en: it was now, quote, his turn to support Turkey, the indictment says.
sentences.zh: 起诉书称，现在“轮到他支持土耳其了”。

sentences.en: The staffer relayed the message, and Adams responded, quote, I know.
sentences.zh: 这名幕僚转达了这条信息，亚当斯回复道：“我知道。”

sentences.en: As in, I know I need to help Turkey because Turkey has helped me.
sentences.zh: 意思是，我知道我需要帮助土耳其，因为土耳其帮助过我。

sentences.en: And then he does just that.
sentences.zh: 然后他就这么做了。

sentences.en: Adams personally intervenes to help get this building open.
sentences.zh: 亚当斯亲自出面干预，帮助这座大楼得以开放。

sentences.en: Fire officials were worried about opening it because there were so many defects with the fire alarm system.
sentences.zh: 消防官员原本担心开放它，因为火灾报警系统存在太多缺陷。

sentences.en: One email quoted that there were more than 60 defects with the system, and that was way too many to grant some sort of waiver.
sentences.zh: 一封电子邮件引用称，该系统有60多个缺陷，数量实在太多，根本无法批准某种豁免。

sentences.en: But once Adams intervenes, the fire officials are worried they're going to lose their job if they don't do what he says.
sentences.zh: 但一旦亚当斯进行干预，消防官员就开始担心如果他们不照他的话做就会丢掉饭碗。

sentences.en: So they did, and they gave the special waiver to allow the Turkish consulate to open.
sentences.zh: 于是他们照办了，给予了特殊豁免，允许土耳其领事馆开放。

sentences.en: When the Turkish official realizes they can open the building, he's really happy, and he texts the mayor directly and says, quote, You are great, Eric.
sentences.zh: 当土耳其官员意识到他们可以开放大楼时，他非常高兴，并直接给市长发短信说：“你太棒了，埃里克。”

sentences.en: We are so happy to hear that.
sentences.zh: 听到这个消息我们太高兴了。

sentences.en: You are a true friend of Turkey.
sentences.zh: 你是土耳其真正的朋友。

sentences.en: Adams replies, quote,
sentences.zh: 亚当斯回复道：

sentences.en: Yes, even more a true friend of yours.
sentences.zh: “是的，更是你真正的朋友。

sentences.en: You are my brother.
sentences.zh: 你是我的兄弟。”

sentences.en: And so this is at the heart of the indictment, that this is a quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是起诉书的核心，这是一场利益交换。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This seems like the definition of public corruption.
sentences.zh: 这简直就是政治腐败的定义。

sentences.en: And the mayor has said he does a lot of favors for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 而市长曾表示，他为很多人帮过很多忙。

sentences.en: He sort of defended this in the past, saying that he helps a lot of people, and that's his job.
sentences.zh: 他过去曾这样辩解，说他帮助了许多人，这就是他的工作。

sentences.en: But now we're learning all of these details behind the scenes of what was happening between him and the Turkish official.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们了解到了他和土耳其官员之间幕后发生的一切细节。

sentences.en: So just how much graft, according to this indictment, does Mayor Adams allegedly end up participating in?
sentences.zh: 那么根据这份起诉书，亚当斯市长涉嫌参与的贪腐究竟有多少？

sentences.en: The tally is at least $100,000.
sentences.zh: 总额至少为10万美元。

sentences.en: But behind that, there's also this effort to cover it up.
sentences.zh: 但在那背后，还有掩盖这一切的行径。

sentences.en: And the indictment has some really interesting examples of how they tried to do that.
sentences.zh: 起诉书里有一些非常有趣的例子，展示了他们是如何试图掩盖的。

sentences.en: Give us at least one or two of those.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲一两个这样的例子吧。

sentences.en: So there's an example of an exchange in 2021.
sentences.zh: 有一个2021年交流的例子。

sentences.en: The airline manager is texting with one of the mayor's staffers.
sentences.zh: 航空公司经理正在和市长的一位幕僚发短信。

sentences.en: They're discussing these travel perks that are worth up to $15,000 airline tickets.
sentences.zh: 他们在讨论这些价值高达15,000美元机票的旅行福利。

sentences.en: And they're trying to hide the real cost of this flight.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图隐瞒这次飞行的真实成本。

sentences.en: And the staffer says, how much does he owe?
sentences.zh: 幕僚问，他欠多少钱？

sentences.en: And the airline manager says, quote, I'm going to charge $50.
sentences.zh: 航空公司经理说：“我要收50美元。”

sentences.en: $50 for something like a $15,000 airline package.
sentences.zh: 价值约15,000美元的机票套餐只收50美元。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the Adams staffer realizes that's way too low and says, no.
sentences.zh: 亚当斯的幕僚意识到这实在太低了，便说，不行。

sentences.en: Quote, a proper price.
sentences.zh: “得定个合适的价钱。”

sentences.en: The airline manager from Turkish Airlines says, how much should I charge, question mark, with a smiley face.
sentences.zh: 土耳其航空公司的经理问，我该收多少钱呢？后面带了个笑脸。

sentences.en: The staffer responds, his every step is being watched right now.
sentences.zh: 幕僚回复道：“他现在每一步都被盯着呢。”

sentences.en: $1,000 or so, let it be somewhat real.
sentences.zh: “1000美元左右吧，让它看起来有点真实感。”

sentences.en: We don't want them to say he's flying for free.
sentences.zh: “我们不想让他们说他是免费坐飞机。”

sentences.en: At the moment, the media's attention is on Eric.
sentences.zh: 当时，媒体的注意力都集中在埃里克身上。

sentences.en: This is right as he's winning the primary for mayor.
sentences.zh: 这正好是他赢得市长初选的时候。

sentences.en: So they don't want the heat.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不想惹火上身。

sentences.en: So they're trying to make this look like a real transaction.
sentences.zh: 因此他们试图让这看起来像是一笔真实的交易。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So there's kind of an open understanding that while Eric Adams seems very enthusiastic about accepting this free stuff from Turkish Airlines,
sentences.zh: 所以大家有一种心照不宣的共识：虽然埃里克·亚当斯似乎对接受土耳其航空公司的这些免费物资表现得非常热心，

sentences.en: that something must be done to make it seem somewhat legitimate, but not enough to actually cover the coSt.
sentences.zh: 但必须做点什么来让它看起来有点合法性，但又不足以真正涵盖成本。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They're going back and forth to try to make this look like legitimate business expenses.
sentences.zh: 他们来回反复，试图把这伪装成合法的商业开支。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And then as this investigation heats up, prosecutors say that the mayor and his staff work together to hide this criminal conduct.
sentences.zh: 随着调查白热化，检察官表示，市长和他的幕僚合伙掩盖这种犯罪行为。

sentences.en: Try to hide it how?
sentences.zh: 怎么个掩盖法？

sentences.en: So remember how I told you federal agents seized the mayor's phones last November.
sentences.zh: 还记得我刚才跟你说过联邦特工去年11月查封了市长的手机吗？

sentences.en: Right, on the street.
sentences.zh: 没错，在街上。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, he didn't have his personal cell phone on him at the time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他当时身上并没有带自己的私人手机。

sentences.en: So when he turns it over to federal officials the next day, he tells federal officials that he's forgotten his password,
sentences.zh: 所以在第二天把它交个联邦官员时，他告诉联邦官员说他忘记了密码，

sentences.en: that he had recently changed it to a new, more complicated password in order to keep his staffers out of his phone.
sentences.zh: 说他最近把它改成了新的、更复杂的密码，是为了不让他的工作人员看他的手机。

sentences.en: And on that day, when he's before federal officials, he can't remember the password.
sentences.zh: 而在那天，当他站在联邦官员面前时，他记不起密码了。

sentences.en: I mean, suffice it to say, most people do not forget their password.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，可以说，大多数人是不会忘记自己的密码的。

sentences.en: And he claims to have forgotten his password, lo and behold, at the precise moment that the FBI wants to get into his phone.
sentences.zh: 而他自称刚好忘记了密码，说来巧了，偏偏就在FBI想要查看他手机的时候。

sentences.en: Yes, and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且美国

sentences.en: attorney called this a clumsy cover-up.
sentences.zh: 检察官称这是一场笨拙的掩盖。

sentences.en: He said this was an attempt to thwart their investigation.
sentences.zh: 他说这是一种试图阻挠他们调查的行为。

sentences.en: Which, it does not appear, worked.
sentences.zh: 不过，这似乎并没有成功。

sentences.en: They still got access to a lot of information on his devices.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然获取了他设备上的大量信息。

sentences.en: So, Emma, it feels hard to call any corruption small or small ball because corruption is corruption.
sentences.zh: 所以，埃玛，要把任何腐败称作小打小闹似乎很难，因为腐败就是腐败。

sentences.en: And parts of this scheme laid out in this indictment are meaningful in their scale.
sentences.zh: 这份起诉书中列出的部分阴谋在规模上是意义重大的。

sentences.en: For example, the matching funds abuse with those donations from foreign nationals.
sentences.zh: 例如，利用外国国民捐款的匹配资金滥用问题。

sentences.en: But I'm struck by how much of this all feels a little bit petty.
sentences.zh: 但让我震惊的是，这一切看起来竟然有那么多小家子气的地方。

sentences.en: Striving for a better airplane seat, a better hotel room, a free meal overseas.
sentences.zh: 争取更好的飞机座位、更好的酒店房间、海外的免费餐食。

sentences.en: And I wonder how you think about that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是怎么看待这一点的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: The mayor really enjoys travel.
sentences.zh: 市长真的很喜欢旅行。

sentences.en: He enjoys eating good meals.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢吃美食。

sentences.en: He enjoys luxury.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢奢侈品。

sentences.en: He has Ferragamo shoes.
sentences.zh: 他有菲拉格慕的鞋子。

sentences.en: He has these really nice suits.
sentences.zh: 他有这些非常漂亮的西装。

sentences.en: One story that stuck out in my mind is I brought a group of high school students to the mayor's office to meet him.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中浮现的一个故事是，我曾带了一群高中生去市长办公室见他。

sentences.en: They got to attend one of his news conferences.
sentences.zh: 他们得以参加他的一场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: We went back to his office.
sentences.zh: 我们回到了他的办公室。

sentences.en: And he brought out his passport all of a sudden and told them the story of how he had grown up poor in Queens and he wanted to see the world.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，他拿出了自己的护照，向他们讲述了自己如何在皇后区贫困长大的故事，以及他想要看看世界的愿望。

sentences.en: He told them they needed to get a passport, that they should dream big.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，他们需要办一本护照，他们应该敢于梦想。

sentences.en: He said he wanted to see a hundred different places around the world and he was getting close to achieving that goal.
sentences.zh: 他说他想看一看世界上不同的上百个地方，而且他离实现这个目标已经不远了。

sentences.en: And along the way, prosecutors say he sought out these perks that he should not have sought out.
sentences.zh: 而与此同时，检察官表示，他一直在寻求这些本不应该寻求的特殊优待。

sentences.en: And that this love for travel, these love for upgrades and luxury could end up being his downfall.
sentences.zh: 而这种对旅行的热爱、对升级和奢侈品的喜爱，最终可能会成为他倒台的原因。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: No matter what his motivation was, I think what's very clear according to this indictment is that this is not anyone's idea of public service.
sentences.zh: 不管他的动机是什么，我认为根据这份起诉书非常清楚的一点是，这绝不符合任何人对公共服务的想象。

sentences.en: Yeah, this wasn't part of his job.
sentences.zh: 是的，这并不是他工作的一部分。

sentences.en: It wasn't necessary.
sentences.zh: 这不是必需的。

sentences.en: And I do think it's a really sad day for New York City.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实认为这对纽约市来说是令人悲伤的一天。

sentences.en: That's what I keep hearing from people, that they're heartbroken, that this is where he has led New York City.
sentences.zh: 这也是我不断从人们那里听到的，他们感到心碎，因为这就是他把纽约市带到的地步。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The mayor came in saying he was going to save the city.
sentences.zh: 市长上任时说他要拯救这座城市。

sentences.en: He was going to help us recover from the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他要帮助我们从大流行中恢复过来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He was going to bring the swagger back.
sentences.zh: 他要让昔日的自信与风采重现。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And now instead, we're in this moment of crisis.
sentences.zh: 而现在取而代之的是，我们正处于危机时刻。

sentences.en: And where do we go from here?
sentences.zh: 接下来我们该去向何方？

sentences.en: What happens now to Eric Adams?
sentences.zh: 埃里克·亚当斯现在会怎么样？

sentences.en: He's facing growing calls to resign.
sentences.zh: 他正面临着越来越多要求他辞职的呼声。

sentences.en: First of all, I want to thank you for being here this morning.
sentences.zh: 首先，我要感谢你今天早晨来到这里。

sentences.en: He held a news conference today and said, I'm not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 他今天举行了一场新闻发布会，并表示：我哪儿也不会去。

sentences.en: The actions that have unfolded over the last 10 months, the leaks, the commentary, the demonizing, this did not surprise us that we reached this day.
sentences.zh: 过去10个月里展开的种种行动、泄密、评论、妖魔化，走到今天这一步并没有让我们感到意外。

sentences.en: He struck a defiant note and said that he was going to stay on as mayor and that he was going to defend himself.
sentences.zh: 他摆出了挑衅的姿态，并表示他将继续担任市长，并为自己辩护。

sentences.en: From here, my attorneys will take care of the case so I can take care of the city.
sentences.zh: 从现在开始，我的律师会处理这个案件，以便我可以照顾这座城市。

sentences.en: My day-to-day will not change.
sentences.zh: 我的日常生活不会改变。

sentences.en: I will continue to do the job for 8.3 million New Yorkers that I was elected to do.
sentences.zh: 我将继续为830万纽约市民做好我被选民选出来要做的工作。

sentences.en: Is that possible?
sentences.zh: 这可能吗？

sentences.en: He doesn't have to step down.
sentences.zh: 他并非必须辞职。

sentences.en: Only the governor, Kathy Hochul, can oust him from the job.
sentences.zh: 只有州长凯西·霍楚才能将他免职。

sentences.en: And it doesn't seem like she wants to do that.
sentences.zh: 而且她似乎并不想这样做。

sentences.en: If he were to resign under immense pressure,
sentences.zh: 如果他在巨大的压力下选择辞职，

sentences.en: then the public advocate would become acting mayor and there would be a special election to pick a new mayor probably by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 那么公众维权专员将成为代理市长，并且很可能会在年底前举行特别选举来选出新市长。

sentences.en: Or the alternative is that the mayor goes on trial early next year.
sentences.zh: 或者另一种选择是，市长将在明年年初接受审判。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: While mayor.
sentences.zh: 以市长的身份。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The trial could happen this spring and this would all be truly unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 审判可能会在今年春天进行，而这一切将真正史无前例。

sentences.en: It's unprecedented to have a mayor who's been charged with a crime and it would be equally unprecedented for that indicted mayor to remain in office.
sentences.zh: 有一个被指控犯罪的市长是史无前例的，而让这位被起诉的市长继续在任也将同样史无前例。

sentences.en: Well, Emma, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，埃玛，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: The arraignment of Mayor Eric Adams is scheduled for noon today inside a federal courthouse in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 市长埃里克·亚当斯的传讯定于今天中午在曼哈顿的一个联邦法院内进行。

sentences.en: Adams is expected to enter a plea of not guilty.
sentences.zh: 预计亚当斯将做无罪抗辩。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Hurricane Helene made landfall on Florida's Gulf Coast on Thursday night as a Category 4 storm.
sentences.zh: 飓风“海伦妮”于周四晚间以4级风暴的强度在佛罗里达州墨西哥湾沿岸登陆。

sentences.en: And the most powerful storm ever to strike Florida's Big Bend region.
sentences.zh: 这也是有史以来袭击佛罗里达州本德地区的威力最强的风暴。

sentences.en: The storm was expected to produce a wall of water up to 20 feet high that could swallow a large stretch of the state's coastline.
sentences.zh: 预计这场风暴将产生高达20英尺高的水墙，可能吞没该州的大片海岸线。

sentences.en: A surge that large is highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 如此规模的风暴潮极其罕见。

sentences.en: For context, the storm surge from Hurricane Katrina, one of the deadliest storms to ever make landfall in the United States, reached 28 feet.
sentences.zh: 作为对比，作为美国登陆过的最致命风暴之一，“卡特里娜”飓风带来的风暴潮达到了28英尺。

sentences.en: The storm is now expected to move on to North Carolina and then Georgia.
sentences.zh: 预计该风暴接下来将移向北卡罗来纳州，然后是佐治亚州。

sentences.en: Remember, you can catch a new episode of The Interview right here tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你明天就可以在这里收看《访谈》的新一期节目。

sentences.en: Lulu Garcia Navarro talks with John Oliver, the host of HBO's Last Week Tonight.
sentences.zh: 露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗与HBO《上周今夜秀》的主持人约翰·奥利弗进行了交谈。

sentences.en: Do you see your show in the same way that it is 10 years from now?
sentences.zh: 你觉得10年后的你的节目还会和现在一样吗？

sentences.en: I mean, if I'm still alive.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果我还活着的话。

sentences.en: You look healthy.
sentences.zh: 你看上去很健康。

sentences.en: Let me just say.
sentences.zh: 请允许我这么说。

sentences.en: I'm going to have to have that statement sent through this building's fact-checkers, and I don't think either of us are going to like the answer that comes back.
sentences.zh: 我得把这句话送交这栋大楼的事实核查人员审核，而且我觉得我们两个都不会喜欢审查出来的结果。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Luke Vanderplug, Shannon Lynn, and Will Reed, with help from Ricky Nevetsky.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卢克·范德普鲁格、香农·林恩和威尔·里德制作，里奇·内韦茨基提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Patricia Willens and MJ Davis-Lynn, contains original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 节目由帕特里夏·威伦斯和MJ·戴维斯-林恩剪辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛萨诺的原创音乐，由阿丽莎·莫克斯利担任工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landfork of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由仙境乐队的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰德福克创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《割草机秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让你的客人宾至如归的技巧。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一沾枕头就睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会晕过去才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app, or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用上或你喜欢收听播客的任何地方寻找《割草机秀》。
